description: Synthetic-workshop automated validation policy with human review separated into optional guidance, as authorized by the user.
pass_definition: A row must satisfy both deterministic checks of actual retrieval, citations, and tool results and the fixed native business judge.
judge_calibration: Every synthetic correct/incorrect control must match its expected verdict. Keep controls separate from target execution results.

human_review.note: Human review is recommended before production use but is not a completion requirement for this educational automated gate. Do not mark unperformed human review as complete.

legacy_evidence: Preserve v1 results and evaluation criteria unchanged as diagnostic and regression material.
